description: The cross-language fixture set. Every case here is run by this package's own node tests AND by each consuming repository's adapter test, against the same files: a Go reader that disagrees with the JavaScript reference implementation about a capability, a transition or a document's validity fails its own suite rather than being discovered later by a user. `capability_matrix` and `transition_matrix` are exhaustive and are GOLDEN — they are generated from the contract and committed, so a change to the table that nobody meant to make fails a test instead of propagating.

invalid.why: The one field the older backlog wanted and this contract refuses: a workspace-wide OFFLINE/LIVE mode. Collaboration state belongs to the asset, so one map can be in a session while another is being edited and a third is idle.
Second-resolution timestamps compare equal across a lease boundary often enough to matter; the contract fixes milliseconds and a literal Z.
A workspace with no name is a workspace nobody can refer to in a modal.
An Overlord chooses max_members; the platform ceiling is not theirs to raise.
`peasant` is the pre-migration role name. AUB rewrote every stored row years of prompts ago and AUC refuses it on the wire; accepting it here would quietly readmit it through a new door.
The one-workspace-per-asset invariant is structural: workspace_id is a single nullable id, so there is nowhere to write a second workspace even by accident.
Revisions count up from zero and never down.
A type the vocabulary does not name has no mutable or realtime_eligible answer, so nothing downstream can decide whether it takes a lease.
A human-readable instance label is a label two devices can collide on. The same-account-second-browser block depends on this value being unforgeably distinct.
There is no lease takeover in V1, so there is no state for one.
Workspace ownership is not a role grant, so an invitation cannot carry it. Exactly one owner, always.
An e-mail address in a durable collaboration record is an e-mail address that eventually reaches a log or a telemetry event. V1 invites an account id.
Ownership cannot be requested through the upgrade mechanism.
Nothing accepts an escalation on the incumbent's behalf. The person holding the current work decides.
A session starts from an exact saved revision. `-1` is what an unsaved browser snapshot would look like.
An empty note is a notification with nothing in it.
The audit record's detail is a closed set of typed facts precisely so that annotation text, geometry and addresses cannot end up in it.
The taxonomy is lower_snake_case, matching AUB's existing reason shape. A second casing is a second vocabulary.
A record from a contract this build does not implement is refused with unsupported_contract_version, never read under whichever rules happen to be compiled in.
The hash is algorithm-prefixed so that comparing two manifests cannot silently compare two different digests.
